card.name: Inside the word antiparkinson
card.fires_on: The "ip" (or "-p") piece partway through "antiparkinson/antiparkinsonian", right before "arkinson". It appears in drug-label text on extrapyramidal symptoms, withdrawal and combined use of other Parkinson's drugs.

modes.label: ant-ip-arkinson
modes.description: The "ip" piece in antiparkinson(ian) written as one word, before agents, drugs or therapy.
modes.example: Extrapyramidal reactions may be treated with anticholinergic ant<<ip>>arkinson agents, diphenhyd

modes.label: anti-Parkinson hyphenated
modes.description: The "-p" or "-P" piece when the word is hyphenated.
modes.example: Extrapyramidal symptoms may be treated with anti<<-p>>arkinsonism drugs, barbitur
